note: Everything scripts/get_data.py can fetch. Paths are relative to the data folder (data/raw by default), which git ignores.

moviesum.about: 2,200 screenplays and summaries with IMDb IDs
moviesum.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; the screenplays are still under copyright, so never commit or publish them

genome.about: MovieLens Tag Genome 2021: IMDb reviews with IMDb IDs
genome.license: CC BY-NC 3.0; cite the two papers named in its readme. Reviews were collected from IMDb, so never commit or publish the text

reviews_hf.about: Large Movie Review Dataset, text and labels without movie IDs
reviews_hf.license: Hugging Face card lists 'other'; read it before publishing anything from the text

review_urls.about: URL lists linking those reviews to movies, from an unofficial mirror with no licence or card

oscars.about: Oscar nominations and wins with IMDb film and person IDs, pinned to one commit
oscars.license: Repo is BSD-2, but it was partly built from Oscars.org and scraped IMDb pages

wikidata.about: Tables queried from Wikidata through QLever, used for Wikipedia links and as a second source
wikidata.license: Wikidata content is reported as CC0
wikidata.prefixes: PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/> PREFIX psv: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/> PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/> PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/> PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>

queries.wiki/wd_tt_enwiki.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?item ?article WHERE { ?item wdt:P345 ?imdb . FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> }
queries.features/wd_budget.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?amt ?unit WHERE { ?i wdt:P345 ?imdb . ?i p:P2130 ?s . ?s psv:P2130 ?v . ?v wikibase:quantityAmount ?amt ; wikibase:quantityUnit ?unit . FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) }
queries.features/wd_gross.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?amt ?unit ?scope WHERE { ?i wdt:P345 ?imdb . ?i p:P2142 ?s . ?s psv:P2142 ?v . ?v wikibase:quantityAmount ?amt ; wikibase:quantityUnit ?unit . OPTIONAL { ?s pq:P3005 ?scope } FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) }
queries.features/wd_studio.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?c ?name WHERE { ?i wdt:P345 ?imdb . ?i wdt:P272 ?c . ?c rdfs:label ?name . FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) }
queries.features/wd_distributor.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?c ?name WHERE { ?i wdt:P345 ?imdb . ?i wdt:P750 ?c . ?c rdfs:label ?name . FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) }
queries.features/wd_scores.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?score ?by ?byName WHERE { ?i wdt:P345 ?imdb . ?i p:P444 ?s . ?s ps:P444 ?score ; pq:P447 ?by . ?by rdfs:label ?byName . FILTER(LANG(?byName)="en") FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) }
queries.features/wd_series.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?s ?name WHERE { ?i wdt:P345 ?imdb . ?i wdt:P179 ?s . OPTIONAL { ?s rdfs:label ?name . FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") } FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) }
queries.features/wd_franchise.tsv: SELECT ?imdb ?s ?name WHERE { ?i wdt:P345 ?imdb . ?i wdt:P8345 ?s . OPTIONAL { ?s rdfs:label ?name . FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") } FILTER(STRSTARTS(?imdb,"tt")) }

not_downloadable.opusdata: Paid extract. Ask sales@opusdata.com; a person has to arrange it.
not_downloadable.tmdb_kaggle: Don't use until the group settles TMDB's terms, which bar use in connection with machine learning applications.
